transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you here today?

I guess… I just haven’t been feeling like myself. I don’t really talk to people much anymore. I kind of go flat and quiet. Even starting my cleaning route feels like… like pushing a loaded cart uphill.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or socializing, don’t interest you anymore?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to look forward to fishing on Saturdays, doing crosswords with my coffee, that kind of thing. Even showing the younger guys little tricks at work, like stripping a floor right. Lately I mostly just… let it all sit. Doesn’t really give me anything back.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days, even when there’s no obvious reason for it?
Yeah… most days. It’s been going on a while now. I’d say since not long after I moved… maybe about a year and a couple months.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you're not worth much lately?

Yeah… some. I keep thinking I messed things up, losing my old place and not keeping my life together. And then little things too… like if the church pantry’s low on supplies, or I miss a hallway at work, it feels like somehow that’s on me. I know that probably doesn’t make sense.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired than usual, even when you haven’t done much, or that you don’t have the energy to do things you normally could?
Yeah… I do. Even if I sleep okay, by the time I get to the building my arms and legs feel heavy. Little stuff, like hauling trash bags, takes more out of me than it should.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slowed down, or that you're moving more slowly than usual, like you're in a fog? Or maybe the opposite, like you can't sit still?
I don’t know… not really sure. I mean, I feel tired and kind of out of it sometimes, but I haven’t paid attention to whether I’m moving slower or anything. I don’t think I’m restless like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately? Like eating a lot less or losing weight without trying?
Yeah… I guess so. Food hasn’t been tasting like much lately. Most days I just skip it or have some crackers after work. My pants are a little looser too.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?
It’s… not the first time I’ve felt low, but this stretch has been going on a long time. Since not long after I moved, I guess. Maybe a year and a couple months now.
